failure_summary.description: New criteria or a proposed attraction location were ignored or handled with a fresh search instead of refining compatible cached results.
Dates and trip duration supplied in response to a clarification were treated as missing, prompting unnecessary information requests.
An import from a nonexistent tools module caused execution failure.

patch.reasoning: The skill already explicitly covers import-free tool use and filtering cached results for follow-up criteria, so repeating those directives would not address a document gap. The clarification-answer cases reveal a narrower ambiguity: a trip start date given for a requested itinerary should also establish hotel check-in when a hotel is part of that same trip and the stay duration is supplied.

edits.target: Still perform every independent requested search or update whose own required inputs are complete in the same turn.
edits.content: - When a user answers a clarification about an already requested trip, map the supplied information to that pending itinerary before deciding anything is missing. For a requested hotel stay tied to the same trip, use the stated trip start date as check-in when no distinct lodging date is given; if the user supplies an unambiguous duration in nights, compute checkout with `adjust_date`. Ask only for required inputs that remain genuinely unknown, and do not request details for domains the user did not request.
